# HaruViru Celebration House

> India's Leading Private 1-Hour Celebration Arenas & 4K Mini-Theaters for Birthdays, Anniversaries & Romantic Surprises.

HaruViru Celebration House provides private, fully air-conditioned celebration spaces equipped with 4K theater screens, Dolby surround sound, ambient neon lighting, custom balloon & floral decor, personalized cakes, and special fog/cold-fire entries. Bookable in flexible 1-hour private slots 24/7.

## Key Information
- **Website**: https://haruviru.com
- **Core Concept**: 100% Private 1-Hour Celebration Arenas (No strangers, only you & your guests)
- **Starting Price**: ₹1,499 per 1-hour slot
- **Operating Hours**: 24/7 (24 one-hour celebration slots per day)
- **Official Customer Support**: +91 97624 86649
- **Official Email**: haruvirucelebrationhouse@gmail.com
- **Franchise Inquiries**: https://haruviru.com/franchise

## Celebration Packages & Inclusions
- **Basic 1-Hour Celebration** (Starts ₹1,499): Private AC Hall, 4K Screening, Dolby Audio, Happy Birthday / Anniversary Backdrop, Ambient Lighting.
- **Silver Celebration Package**: Custom Theme Decor, Personalized Photo Display on 4K Screen, Party Fog Entry, 500g Cake.
- **Gold / Platinum Romantic Date Package**: Complete Candlelight Setup, Rose Petal Walkway, Cold Fire Gun Entry, Premium Cake, Photography assistance.
- **Add-Ons Available**: Extra Hour Extension, Custom Flavored Cakes, Cold Fire Sparkulars, Balloon Bouquets, Popcorn & Refreshments.

## Frequently Asked Questions
- **Q: Is HaruViru 100% private?**
  A: Yes. When you book a slot, the entire hall/mini-theater is reserved exclusively for you and your invited guests. No other parties are allowed inside during your slot.
- **Q: How to book a slot?**
  A: Visit https://haruviru.com/branches, pick your preferred location, select the date and 1-hour time slot, and confirm with advance deposit or full UPI payment.
